Machine Learning (BMI/GEO/WNA) 
Code Assignment U1A1  
Linear Regression 
This is NOT a group Assignment. 
 
10 marks 
Please complete seeing the videos for Week 1-2 before attempting this 
assignment.  
 
Use real estate valuation regression dataset : 
https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/477/real+estate+valuation+data+set  from the 
UCI repository, and use google colab to code. 
 
First, download the csv file, and open it in your computer and analyze the data. 
Try to understand what the data is about. Read through the data description 
given 
in 
the 
UCI 
website 
as 
well. 
 
Section A 
Answer the following questions [1 mark if you answer all the below 
questions] : 
1. How many samples are there? 
414 
2. How 
many 
input 
variables 
are 
there? 
6 
3. Which 
column 
is 
the 
output 
variable 
(target 
outcome)? 
Y house price of unit area 
4. What does each of the input columns mean ? 
The input columns describe characteristics or features of the Real 
estate asset. 
 
Section B 
For each of the questions below, you need to put in the screenshot of the code 
and its output. You could use the sample google colab file that is provided with 
this assignment.

Page 2/7 
1. Understanding the dataset [4 marks] 
There are many input variables in this dataset. Use only X1 to X4 as input 
variables, and y as the output variable. 
Using the scatter plots between each of the input features (X1-X4) and the 
output (Y), which input variable, do you think, is better in predicting the 
output / target variable ?

Page 5/7 
 
 We can observe that a closer proximity to the MRT station and the 
existence of convenience stores within the living area have led to a 
more linear growth in the cost of a unit area housing. 
 There doesn't seem to be a lot of variation in the remaining plots. 
2. Write code to find out how many samples are there in total in this dataset? [1 
mark] 
 
 
3. What is the train test split ratio that you have chosen ? [1 Mark]

Page 6/7 
 
I have selected an 80:20 split ratio for the train and test sets. 
 
4. Evaluate the linear regression model by computing the MAE, MSE and Mean 
Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) . 
(for MAPE - pls refer to the sample here - https://scikit-
learn.org/stable/modules/generated/sklearn.metrics.mean_absolute_percentage_
error.html)  
[3 marks] 
 
5. What are the 3 new things that you learned after you completed this 
assignment ? 
 Discovered how to build code to create the csv file shown below from 
an xlsx file. given that the provided file is in ‘xlsx’ format. 
 I now know how to analyze the data and use it to draw conclusions 
that are useful in real-world situations  
 Learned how to train and test models in the dataset.
